newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: RUGBY UNION-AUSTRALIA THRASH MUNSTER.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-AUSTRALIA THRASH MUNSTER.

text.p: Australia demolished Munster 55-19 on Tuesday with a late burst of scoring.
Ben Tune's early try for Australia was converted by full back Steve Larkham, who had an outstanding game.
Fly half Kilian Keane revived Munster's hopes with two penalty goals, before Totai Kefu scored Australia's second try.
A dropped goal by Pat Murray kept Munster in the hunt, before Larkham converted tries by David Campese and Sam Payne to leave the Wallabies 24-9 ahead at halftime.
Keane converted his own try just after the restart, before Owen Finegan's try for Australia was converted by Larkham. Keane added a third penalty goal to end Munster's challenge.
Larkham converted tries by Campese again and Jason Little before replacement wing Alistair Murdoch crossed for two unconverted tries to bring the drubbing to an end.
